Software qualification

Quick readMore contextTechnical detailSpeaker notes

We rewrote part of our scientific tooling in Mojo and checked it against the established implementation. Across 24 cases both gave exactly the same answers. Then we compared against independent mathematical references. Float64 passed. Float32 failed. So two programs can agree perfectly and still miss the target. Agreement and accuracy are different questions. We kept the failure on the record. Nothing was rerun for this talk.

Scope: S02-I, 20 August 2026. Overall protocol: failed. Applies to the tested stencil and environment. No new GPU run, speed qualification, or physical-feasibility finding.
